flawed_step: 0005: The displayed identity is false. Its right-hand side telescopes to a^{p(p-1)}-1, not a^{p(p-1)-1}.
counterexample: Take p=5 and a=32. This meets the preceding assumption because 32^4 ≡ 7^4 ≡ 1 (mod 25). Step 0005 claims 32^19=(32^4-1)((32^4)^4+(32^4)^3+(32^4)^2+32^4+1). But the right-hand side equals (32^4)^5-1=32^20-1, which is not 32^19 (their difference is 31·32^19-1>0).
assessment_summary: Verification stops at step 0005, the first definite failure. The intended identity was evidently a^{p(p-1)}-1=(a^{p-1}-1)(...), but that is not what the numbered proof states.
